description: This file defines the ImageCacheUtils object providing utilities for managing image caches (using Coil) and canceling ongoing image requests within an Android TV front-end project. It includes functions to clear memory and disk caches, and to cancel image loading requests tied to ImageView instances, mainly for testing or debug purposes.

classes.name: ImageCacheUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utilities to clear image caches and cancel ongoing image requests, mainly used for testing and debugging scenarios.

methods.name: clearAllCoilCaches
methods.description: Suspending function that clears Coil's memory and disk caches, requiring an Android Context. Useful for simulating first-run cache conditions during testing.

methods.name: cancelOngoingRequest
methods.description: Function to cancel any ongoing image request linked to a specific ImageView, preventing content flash or reuse issues during view rebinding.
